limitations.GH-DEF-052: PROVISIONAL CONVENTION, owner approval required (Phase 0 decision D7, still open): Turn Radius R measured from the turn centre to the midpoint of the rear axle, T = front track between wheel centres, inside angle = atan(L / (R - T/2)). The shipped calculator has no Track Width input, so KA-21 is RED only because that input is missing; the inside-angle value is checked only on the temporary probe copy, which adds the input and relabels Turn Radius as measured to the rear-axle centreline. This does NOT validate the existing two-input UI, and does NOT validate the shipped label "Turn Radius (to outside wheel path)", whose measurement point is undefined: for 108 / 300 / 60 the inside angle is 26.16 deg if 300 is the outside FRONT wheel-centre radius, 24.23 deg only if 300 is the outside REAR wheel-centre radius (lateral distance to the outside track), 23.37 deg to the front-axle midpoint. See premium/tests/ackermann-reference.test.js.
